cases.U-a15:
# ADR 0764 (F-868) run U-a15; ADR 0760's case SA-a15 with the tables [solver] and [output] replaced
title = "NACA 0012, alpha 15 deg, time-accurate SA (pimple, bdf2, dt 0.02), both fixes, mesh M1w-far500 (ADR 0764, F-868)"

[mesh]
source = "file"
file = "../meshes/M1w-far500"

[mesh.transform]
rotate_z_deg = -15   # angle of attack 15 deg: the aerofoil turns by -alpha about the quarter chord (ADR 0155)
rotate_origin = [0.25, 0.0, 0.0]

[physics]
nu = 1.6666666666666667e-7   # Re = U c / nu = 6e6

[initial]
velocity = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]

[boundaries.airfoil]
velocity = "fixed"

[boundaries.farfield]
velocity = "freestream"
velocity_value = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
pressure = "freestream"
turbulence = "freestream"   # ADR 0164 amendment 1 (opt-in): nuTilda = 3 nu on the inflow faces, zero gradient on the outflow faces

[reports.cl]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "total"   # ADR 0167: the molecular wall shear (today's default), written out

[reports.cd]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "total"   # ADR 0167: the molecular wall shear (today's default), written out

[turbulence]
model = "spalart_allmaras"

[solver]
algorithm = "pimple"
time_scheme = "bdf2"
n_outer = 3
n_correctors = 2
corrector_control = "adaptive"
convection = "linear_upwind"
dt = 0.02
end_time = 200.0

[output]
store_time_interval = 200.0
store_precision = "f32"
store_fields = ["ux", "uy", "p", "nut"]

# ADR 0167: the effective force (ADR 0164 D1), the curve's values; and the parts of cd (reports do not change the solution)
[reports.cl_eff]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "total_effective"

[reports.cd_eff]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "total_effective"

[reports.cd_p]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "pressure"

[reports.cd_veff]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "viscous_effective"

[reports.nut_avg]
type = "volume_average"
field = "nut"
